page_title: MCI 5-1 FUL | Manchester City v Fulham 02/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' 5 - 1 Fantastic team goal! Erling Haaland (Manchester City) was set free in the area by Sergio Gomez and he made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom left corner. 5:1.
90+5' Neat passing move from Manchester City in order to create new attacking opportunities.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rico Lewis (Manchester City) comes onto the pitch for Julian Alvarez.
90' Oscar Bobb (Manchester City) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Phil Foden.
86' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Bernd Leno comes off the line to clear the ball away.
84' Juan Manuel Lillo Diez has decided to make a change. Kalvin Phillips (Manchester City) replaces Mateo Kovacic.
84' The corner is swung in but Manchester City can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
82' A spell of possession for Manchester City in an attempt to control the game.
81' The substitution is prepared. Adama Traore (Fulham) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Harry Wilson.
81' It is time for a substitution. Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) is on for Raul Jimenez.
78' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
76' Juan Manuel Lillo Diez prepares a substitution. Jeremy Doku is replaced by Sergio Gomez (Manchester City).
76' Here's the change. Rodri leaves the pitch and Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) comes on as a substitute.
75' Fulham are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
75' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) will deliver the corner kick.
75' Fulham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The ball goes out of play. Fulham are awarded a corner kick.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Bobby De Cordova-Reid departs the field of play to be replaced by Willian (Fulham).
73' Here is a change. Kenny Tete is going off and Marco Silva gives the last tactical orders to Timothy Castagne (Fulham).
70' 4 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Erling Haaland (Manchester City) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Bernd Leno no chance!
69' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
69' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is arguing with the referee and is given a caution.
69' Referee Michael Oliver is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Manchester City!
69' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Manchester City, he's going to review using VAR.
65' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

64' Julian Alvarez nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Erling Haaland (Manchester City), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance. Manchester City force a corner. They send men into the box.

58' 3 - 1 Goal! Erling Haaland (Manchester City) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. Bernd Leno is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 3:1.
57' The ball possession at the moment is 61:39.
54' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) picks up a caution.
54' Michael Oliver blows his whistle and it's Luke Harris (Fulham) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

52' Manchester City slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.

47' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies into the stands. The ball goes out of play and Manchester City will have a goal kick.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+8' The end of the first half.
45+6' Michael Oliver sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
45+6' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Manchester City players aren’t happy.
45+5' 2 - 1 Phil Foden takes the corner and Nathan Ake (Manchester City) rises highest near the penalty spot to plant a brilliant header into the bottom left corner. The score is 2:1.
45+5' Phil Foden (Manchester City) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
45+4' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Phil Foden (Manchester City), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Manchester City will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
45+3' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
45+1' Kenny Tete (Fulham) is able to continue to play.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
44' Kenny Tete (Fulham) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
44' The free kick from Phil Foden (Manchester City) failed to provide any scoring opportunity, as one of the defenders did a good job and knocked it out.
43' Issa Diop (Fulham) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
43' Michael Oliver blows his whistle after Issa Diop (Fulham) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Manchester City get a free kick.
41' Rodri (Manchester City) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
40' Harrison Reed (Fulham) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul.
38' Harry Wilson (Fulham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
37' Manchester City keep possession of the ball by producing one-two passes, but an opponent steps in and wins the ball.
33' 1 - 1 Tim Ream (Fulham) gets on the end of the corner kick deep inside the box and beats the keeper with a precise strike into the bottom left corner.
33' Fulham force their opponents to concede a corner.
31' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Michael Oliver to decide. The relieved Manchester City players can finally celebrate.
31' Wait! The referee has now indicated he wants to check if the goal for Manchester City can stand using VAR.
31' 1 - 0 Goal! Erling Haaland tees up Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to score low into the middle of the goal. 1:0.
28' Phil Foden (Manchester City) tries to find Erling Haaland with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
26' Phil Foden receives a sweet cross inside the box from Jeremy Doku (Manchester City), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.
23' Bernd Leno (Fulham) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. It's a throw-in for Manchester City.
21' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

20' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes behind for a corner. Fulham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

19' Fulham show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. The ball has crossed the sideline. Manchester City are taking a throw-in.
16' Marco Silva is forced to make a change. Tom Cairney is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Luke Harris (Fulham).
16' Tom Cairney (Fulham) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

14' Mateo Kovacic almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Phil Foden (Manchester City) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Manchester City.
12' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
11' Fulham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
10' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham). The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Fulham.

8' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
7' Phil Foden (Manchester City) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
6' Issa Diop (Fulham) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
6' Phil Foden (Manchester City) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
5' Rodri (Manchester City) was too forceful with his tackle and Michael Oliver interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
2' Manchester City are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Manchester City will have the kick-off.
Michael Oliver is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
